$comment: High/critical npm audit advisories accepted for now. scripts/check-npm-audit.mjs fails CI on any advisory not listed here and on any entry past reviewBy. Each entry says why the risk is acceptable; delete it when the fix lands.

advisories.title: Zod can exhaust memory while validating oversized constrained collections
advisories.reason: Root zod is 3.24.2; the fix is only in zod 4.6.6+, a major bump that touches every schema in src. The nested zod copies under creem and the MCP SDK are already overridden to 4.6.7. Move to zod 4 as its own change.
